decision_rule: Later/lower-authority specs add detail but cannot weaken higher-authority legal, financial, security, runtime or source truth. Conflict resolutions preserve deterministic truth and existing authorities.

conflicts.requirement: Separate repository capability from delivery progress so EXISTING never means VERIFIED.
conflicts.resolution: Use capability_state=EXISTING|PARTIAL|TARGET and delivery_status=NOT_STARTED|IN_PROGRESS|IMPLEMENTED|VERIFIED|BLOCKED|DEFERRED|SUPERSEDED. Runtime qualifiers remain blockers.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Resolve normative conflicts using the orchestration precedence chain.
conflicts.resolution: Verifiable legal/financial/security/runtime truth outranks source code, evidence, specs and conversation; CIV2 outranks ORCH, then CPIC, then ALI.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Prevent probabilistic or language outputs from overwriting financial truth.
conflicts.resolution: P3/rates, merchant inputs and Verified Savings remain deterministic sources; CPIC outputs versioned estimates/distributions only.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Avoid parallel evidence registries.
conflicts.resolution: Reuse IntelligenceEvidence as intelligence evidence ledger; EvidenceAssertion/Attestation retain domain verification roles and reference canonical evidence rather than becoming a second learning ledger.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Avoid duplicate learning outcome sources while preserving domain truth.
conflicts.resolution: IntelligenceOutcome is the canonical learning projection; billing, Verified Savings, GrowthDecisionOutcome and acquisition records remain domain truth and are referenced, not replaced.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Reconcile merchant/company/provider/contact identities without destructive fusion.
conflicts.resolution: Brand stays merchant/tenant authority; OutboundLead stays company-candidate master; Provider stays operational provider authority pending CanonicalProvider migration evidence; contact identity remains TARGET with explicit links/merge lineage.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Prevent a third provider authority.
conflicts.resolution: Do not create a new provider master. Audit runtime data before deciding Provider↔CanonicalProvider cutover or adapter.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Resolve physical-table ambiguity.
conflicts.resolution: One semantic envelope is mandatory. Phase 1 extends Event only with backwards-compatible optional fields and projects existing snapshots, evidence, authority, costs and outcomes through a shared validator; domain records stay authoritative and no new event table is created.
conflicts.notes: Contract and additive schema are implemented locally. They do not prove runtime integration, exactly-once persistence or tenant enforcement.

conflicts.requirement: Distinguish thread history, company state and governed memory.
conflicts.resolution: Reuse CommunicationThread/Message, CompanyMemory and KnowledgeClaim by role; a universal retrieval contract is TARGET and must not be claimed from thread history alone.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Prevent CPIC from duplicating P4 statistical intelligence.
conflicts.resolution: Extend P4StatisticalEstimate/P4EvidenceProjection and existing benchmark baselines with common distribution/support contracts. CPIC is the shared mathematical layer, not a parallel benchmark store.
conflicts.notes: The shared CPIC V0 contract and P4 adapters are locally implemented without a second store/function. No runtime, registered-model or calibration claim is implied.

conflicts.requirement: Ensure one future training control plane.
conflicts.resolution: Phase 0 created no model infrastructure. Phase 1 now defines one shared contract-only registry family for Feature, Label, Dataset, Model and Prediction plus one fail-closed Evaluation Harness contract. They contain zero records and create no Feature Store, TrainingRun, artifact, serving runtime or production model; one future lifecycle serves all domains.
conflicts.notes: The compatibility decision is materialized as empty schemas and a pure validator only. It does not verify referenced evidence or prove a Model Factory or any trained/proprietary model.

conflicts.requirement: Use one evaluation philosophy across Intelligence v2, CPIC and Adaptive Lead.
conflicts.resolution: All domains add task-specific metrics through evaluation-harness.v1 while sharing one problem, holdout, segment, calibration, safety, cost, reproducibility and promotion contract. Domain-specific evaluators may not create a second promotion authority or bypass the shared hard failures.
conflicts.notes: The shared harness is contract-only. A structurally valid packet remains evidence-unverified, human-review-required and unable to promote or serve a model.

conflicts.requirement: Unify paid research, inference and training costs.
conflicts.resolution: CostBudgetControl + CostUsageEvent + costGovernance are canonical. Every paid action reserves before execution and reconciles actual spend; no parallel budget ledger.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Separate recommendations/models from authority.
conflicts.resolution: Approval, AuthoritySnapshot, MandateAuthority and emergency controls remain deterministic. Models/agents cannot approve, sign, spend, charge, certify savings or expand authority.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Unify privacy rules across evidence, learning and serving.
conflicts.resolution: Tenant-specific data stays isolated; cross-tenant learning only through approved privacy-safe aggregates with k≥10 and purpose/retention/deletion enforcement.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Reconcile UI-driven and scheduled Discovery into one backend-owned lifecycle.
conflicts.resolution: Extend DiscoveryExecutionRun and existing routed backend entry points. Manual and scheduled paths must converge; no new super-orchestrator or physical function is justified in Phase 0.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Prevent inbound, provider and outbound lead conflation.
conflicts.resolution: OutboundLead remains outbound company candidate; Lead/LeadCapture remain inbound; ProviderLead remains provider-domain. Link explicitly; do not merge by similar names.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Protect billing truth from estimated value.
conflicts.resolution: Probabilistic savings and expected value are advisory. Only deterministic verified/reconciled domain evidence may drive billing.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Avoid another Brain/Foundry service.
conflicts.resolution: Route through existing bounded orchestrators/workers and shared contracts. A new physical orchestration function needs an ADR proving existing entry points cannot safely route it.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Keep provider IDs out of canonical candidates and outcomes.
conflicts.resolution: Provider adapters project external IDs into source references; canonical company/candidate/experience identity survives Apollo/Instantly/other provider transitions.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.

conflicts.requirement: Prevent source presence from becoming a production claim.
conflicts.resolution: All current capability mappings are static only. No integration/model/production seal can pass without immutable source identity, runtime parity and attributable runtime evidence.
conflicts.notes: Resolution is architectural/static. It does not prove runtime integration.
